channel.title: CamGrader Help Center
channel.description: Guides and tutorials for grading paper tests with CamGrader.

item.title: Quick Start
item.description: New to CamGrader? Start here. These three tutorials walk you through creating your first test, scanning it, and using the online key generator.

item.title: Create Your First Test
item.description: How to create a test and set up its answer key in CamGrader, by scanning a paper key, using the Key Generator, or entering it manually.

item.title: Scan Your First Test
item.description: Lighting tips, scanning do's and don'ts, and how to read the color-coded Question Breakdown on a CamGrader results page.

item.title: How to Use the Online Key Generator
item.description: Step-by-step guide to CamGrader's online Key Generator: choose a sheet format, enter your answers, and get a ready-to-scan key.

item.title: Deploy Your First Test
item.description: Ready to hand a test to your class? These tutorials cover printing sheets, scanning student results, and managing them afterward.

item.title: Choose the Right Sheet Format
item.description: When to use 25Q, 50Q, or 100Q sheets, and how to use a larger sheet for a shorter test.

item.title: Download and Print Answer Sheets
item.description: Get the right answer sheet format, choose a darkness level, and print correctly.

item.title: How to Use the Student ID Section
item.description: How the Student ID section works on a CamGrader bubble sheet, including null IDs and how to edit a student's ID after scanning.

item.title: Editing Student Results
item.description: How to correct a misread or ambiguous answer on a student's CamGrader results page using Edit mode.

item.title: Re-grade a Test
item.description: Edit your answer key and CamGrader automatically recalculates every student's score.

item.title: Results & Export
item.description: Export tutorials: export grades to CSV and export individual student results as a PDF.

item.title: Export Grades to CSV
item.description: Export your class results as a CSV file and open it in Google Sheets, Excel, or your gradebook.

item.title: Export Student Results
item.description: Export an individual student's result as a PDF with their answer sheet thumbnail and per-question breakdown.

item.title: Account & Billing
item.description: Tutorials on upgrading to CamGrader Personal and managing your subscription.

item.title: Manage or Cancel Your Subscription
item.description: How to view invoices, update your payment method, or cancel your CamGrader Personal subscription.

item.title: Upgrade to CamGrader Personal
item.description: How to upgrade from Guest Mode to CamGrader Personal for unlimited scans.

item.title: Backup and Restore
item.description: What backup and restore look like for CamGrader Guests, signed-in free accounts, and subscribers.
